fields.Institution: Footwear Design and Development Institute (FDDI), Noida
fields.Approval / Accreditation: Institution of National Importance under FDDI Act, 2017
fields.Programmes: Numeric reference: MBA (Retail & Fashion Merchandise / programme specialisations) [NCR-171]
fields.Fees — Published:
₹5.86 lakh gross for 2026–28, including ₹10,000 refundable deposit and ₹3,000 alumni fee; hostel/mess excluded
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 5.76
fields.Fee Scope: ₹5.86 lakh gross less ₹0.10 lakh refundable security = ₹5.76 lakh; ₹0.03 lakh alumni fee retained; hostel/mess extra
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: Institute test; no CAT percentile published
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an institute/university recognised by Indian law; no upper age limit for MBA. Provisional candidates had to submit qualifying results by 30 September 2026.
fields.Selection Process: AIST rank-based admission/counselling; valid national entrance-score applicants may be exempt from AIST and mapped to AIST percentile/rank for vacant seats under 2026–27 rules.
fields.Placement Scope: Official 2025–26 student list covers all FDDI campuses/programmes and lists employers, without CTC. MBA Noida-only salary is not established.
fields.Top Recruiters: Official all-campus recruiter list available via placement page. MBA Noida-specific roster requires filtering.
fields.Official Role Examples: Retail Merchandiser; Buyer; Category Manager; Visual Merchandising Manager; Store/Area Manager; Luxury Retail Manager; E-commerce Manager; Digital Marketing Manager
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Category Manager; Merchandiser/Buyer; Retail Operations; E-commerce; Procurement & Logistics
fields.Ranking: Not separately ranked in NIRF Management
fields.Notes: Added in October 2026 audit. Official prospectus confirms Noida MBA intake and role pathways. Programme-specific salary outcomes were not published, so no estimate is presented as fact. | Corrected refund adjustment: the non-refundable alumni fee remains in the programme fee basis. | 2026-10-16 research: Official placement register lacks compensation data, so MBA CTC cannot be derived from employers alone. A secondary campus review benchmark remains separately labelled.
fields.Intake Evidence: Previously published; year / programme scope applies
fields.Current Audit Note: 18 Oct 2026 public-source review. Checked: Noida MBA2026–28 gross ₹5.86 L/net ₹5.76 L after ₹10 k refundable deposit; 50 seats; degree eligibility. Noida fee table kept separate from lower-priced FDDI campuses. Recruiter register contains no usable compensation summary.
fields.Research CTC basis:
Shiksha Noida campus reviews report ₹3 lakh average; ₹3.5 lakh appears in a campus-wide claim. No validated MBA-specific cohort mean.
Research CTC low ₹L: 3; Research CTC high ₹L: 3.5
fields.Research Status: Public sources reviewed; unresolved details explicitly flagged
